prBodyNotes: **Manual step:** update `rustfs_molecule_rc_checksum` next to the bumped `rustfs_molecule_rc_version` in `extensions/molecule/default/inventory/group_vars/all.yml` (the rc CLI is a molecule-only drift injector since 2.0.0). A stale checksum fails safe as a red download in molecule.

**Manual step:** re-verify the marked items in `docs/server-quirks.md` after a server image bump (`make test` first; the 501-stubbed group API, 500-as-not-found shapes, and policy-info envelope are pinned to beta-8). Both molecule scenarios pin this image and must move together.
